current_verdict.verdict_reason: Both locales parse, the parameter sets agree, every kind arm exists in both with all seven codes plus other, all 21 rows render sensibly, French carries no English verb or noun, and English byte-compatibility holds where it must (all seven project codes; added/updated/removed milestones). findings.problem: The other arm has no noun, so nothing anchors the participle's gender or number; a future caller routing a feminine or plural subject through kind=other would render a wrong agreement (Session X supprimé.).
findings.suggested: If other ever gains a caller, name the noun (Élément {subject} {action}.) or avoid an agreeing participle.

findings.current: the other kind arm is asserted once per locale (deleted only)
findings.problem: A future action added to the project and milestone arms but forgotten in the other arm would silently fall back to mis à jour / Updated rather than fail.
findings.suggested: Extend the RECEIPT_VERBS loop over the other kind arm.
